description: This file defines the SaveQualificationLanguageController class, which handles the pre-render logic for qualification language forms in the OrangeHRM system. It extends AbstractVueController and manages Vue.js components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLanguageController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for setting up Vue component state for qualification language forms, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering; chooses component and sets properties based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.
